name: Orange Hound 27
author: gharsh11032000
description: Neon rounded sky-blue button that glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, border-color becomes #0974f1, box-shadow becomes 0 0 20px #0975f1.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Orange Hound 27</title>
<style>
/* Orange Hound 27 by gharsh11032000 — https://uiverse.io/gharsh11032000/orange-hound-27 */
.button {
  padding: 15px 20px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  border: 2px solid #414141;
  color: white;
  background-color: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 10px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.320, 1);
}

.button:hover {
  border-color: #0974f1;
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(9, 117, 241, 0.8);
}

.button:active {
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(9, 117, 241, 0.4);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Hover me
</button>

</body>
</html>
